description: Use this when the user wants to set up an SPV or a fund — to pool investors’ money into one deal, such as buying a startup’s or a pre-IPO company’s shares, or to raise a blind pool — or asks how to start one. Starts setting up the fund in Capital Company: an SPV or a blind pool, with its legal name, expected allocation, strategy, classes and fees, manager and documents. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or a proposed fund for the user to confirm. This call creates nothing.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York

name: capital_company_create_fund
title: Create a fund
